stories.title: Eala Dethrones Fernandez — DC Open WTA QF Bound After Stunning Sweep
stories.angle: NEW STORY (follow-up to July 28 Story 3 preview) — Alexandra Eala (Philippines, No. 28 WTA) knocked out defending DC Open champion Leylah Fernandez 6-2, 7-6(7/1) on Wednesday July 29, rallying from 5-1 down in the second set to reach the quarterfinals in Washington. One day earlier, Eala had defeated Qinwen Zheng (former Olympic champion) 4-6, 6-4, 6-1 in a comeback win from a set down. Eala is unseeded and has now beaten two high-profile opponents in back-to-back days. Context: Eala reached the Wimbledon R4 in July after defeating Rybakina and Swiatek; she now holds a career-high ranking of No. 28 and won the WTA Star of the Swing award. QF schedule: Friday July 31.

stories.title: DC Open ATP — de Minaur Opens Defense; Shelton, Mensik, Fritz All Advance
stories.angle: NEW STORY — Alex de Minaur (1, AUS, defending champion) defeated Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 in Round 1 on Wednesday July 29, snapping a 12-1 career deficit to Tsitsipas. Ben Shelton (2) defeated Ugo Humbert 6-4, 4-6, 6-4 in Round 2 on Thursday July 30. Jakub Mensik (7) defeated Brandon Nakashima 6-2, 6-7(5), 6-3 in Round 2. Taylor Fritz (3) defeated Kamil Majchrzak 6-3, 6-4 and will face Alex Michelsen in the QF. Also: 19-year-old Spaniard Rafael Jodar upset No. 8 seed Arthur Fils 7-6(5), 6-3 on Tuesday and then beat Kei Nishikori 6-3, 6-2 on Wednesday. Learner Tien (5) was upset in R1 by Adrian Mannarino. American men are struggling — Fils, Tien both gone. QF: Friday July 31.

stories.title: DC Open WTA Upsets — Svitolina, Shnaider Fall; Wild QF Draw
stories.angle: NEW STORY — The DC Open WTA has seen two major seeding upsets in the round of 16: No. 2 seed Elina Svitolina was eliminated by Polina Kudermetova 5-7, 7-6(4), 6-0 and No. 4 seed Diana Shnaider was beaten by Anna Kalinskaya 6-4, 6-1. No. 1 seed Jessica Pegula defeated Magdalena Frech 6-4, 6-3 and is through to the QF. No. 3 seed Naomi Osaka defeated Ashlyn Krueger 3-6, 6-2, 6-2. Emma Navarro def. Elisabetta Cocciaretto 6-0, 7-5. Also: Venus Williams was eliminated in Round 1 by Anastasia Potapova 6-3, 6-3 — Williams' losing streak extended to 12 matches, and she has not won a match in 2026. QF Friday July 31.

stories.title: Canadian Open Preview — Sinner Out, Draws Friday, FAA at Home
stories.angle: FOLLOW-UP (July 28 Story 5) — The Canadian Open draws ceremony is Friday July 31. Big news: Jannik Sinner (World No. 1) has withdrawn from ATP Montreal, citing rest ahead of Cincinnati; the tournament director publicly criticized the ATP over the withdrawal. Sinner joins Djokovic and Alcaraz as no-shows for ATP Montreal — the full top-three absent. On the WTA side, defending Toronto champion Victoria Mboko is out (injury), as is Karolina Muchova and Emma Raducanu. ATP seeds: Zverev (1), Felix Auger-Aliassime (2, playing at home in Montreal). WTA seeds: Sabalenka (1), Rybakina (2), Pegula (3), Gauff (4), Noskova (6, Wimbledon champion). Main draws begin Aug 2 (WTA) and Aug 4 (ATP).
